qrScannerModal.title: Add Device
qrScannerModal.subtitle: Align the QR code on your device inside the frame. We verify it, then register the WiFi node.

rightAction.label: I don't have QR
rightAction.title: I don't have QR — enter node ID

manualEntry.title: Enter Node ID
manualEntry.subtitle: Type the device node ID to connect. We verify it, then register the node — same as scanning the QR code.

hero.subtitle: Align the QR code on your device inside the frame. We verify it, then register the node.

flow.label: Scan
flow.statusMessage: Point your camera at the device QR code…

showAlert.title: Device Added
showAlert.message: Device added successfully. You can now control it from My Devices.

identity.product_id: Unique efactorproduct row id (primary list key)
identity.id: Same as product_id — stable device list id
identity.node_id: Hardware node id — use for control APIs (power, card click)

model.model_no: Model number alias used by mobile apps (same as model_number)
model.modelName: Model display name from DB model_name

node.node.is_added: Whether device is added to gateway

product.productName: Device type label from device_type column
product.name: Alias of product_name

node.node_id: Hardware node id — primary control key
node.devices: Child device states attached to this node/gateway
node.status.connectivity.connected: Online connectivity flag (string true/false legacy compatible)

device.devices[].id: Device/node id used for control commands
device.devices[].name: Runtime device name from model table

addDevice.note: Scan QR → checkDevice → addWifiNode. Replaces decorative header house icon.

manualNodeId.note: Header QR button opens a node ID prompt. Submit runs the same checkDevice → addWifiNode flow as a scan.

powerToggle.note: Functional control — POST device_power_toggle via dataSources.powerToggle. Binds to iot-toggle / powerApiToggle UI.

confirmDialog.title: Delete Device
confirmDialog.message: Remove this device from your account? This cannot be undone.

showAlert.title: Device Deleted
showAlert.message: Device has been removed from your account.

getAllNodesStatus.label: Fetch live node connectivity and power states

auth.note: Web clients POST to logged-in session proxy with server-resolved token.

nativeApi.note: Flutter native: Bearer token in Authorization header.

checkDevice.label: Verify scanned device node
checkDevice.note: POST https://efactor.tech/v8/iot_api_creation.php?action=check_device — Authorization header, JSON body {node_id, latitude, longitude}.

addWifiNode.label: Add verified WiFi node to account
addWifiNode.note: POST https://efactor.tech/v8/iot_api_creation.php?action=add_wifi_node&node_id={node_id} — Authorization header, JSON body {node_id, latitude, longitude}.

webProxy.note: Web-session proxy — do NOT use for mobile clients without a session cookie.

removeDevice.label: Remove device node from account

auth.note: CI session proxy — resolves token server-side from logged-in user.

node_id.description: The node_id of the device to remove. Must be the runtime device.node_id — never a schema-time constant.

nativeApi.note: Flutter native: Bearer token in Authorization header, node_id in JSON body only.

removeDevice.note: POST app-home-page/api/remove-node (web proxy) or v8/iot_api_creation.php?action=remove_node (native). Authorization header, JSON body {node_id}. Response includes refreshed devices[].
